3634973.title: Markdown Viewer: one workspace across browser and desktop
3634973.summary: A closer look at document tabs, desktop delivery, GitHub imports and sharing documents through a URL.
3634973.intro: The latest Markdown Viewer rebuild brings document management, rendering and sharing into one workspace. This article explains the changes to multi-tab sessions, desktop delivery, GitHub imports and URL-based sharing, alongside the decisions behind them.

2488718.title: Inside Markdown Viewer 2.0
2488718.summary: Extending a live-preview editor with diagrams, mathematical notation, syntax highlighting and a more complete writing interface.
2488718.intro: Markdown Viewer 2.0 expands the original split-pane editor with diagrams, mathematical notation, syntax highlighting and an updated interface. This release overview covers the features added to support a broader technical-writing workflow.

2016959.title: Managing public membership in large GitHub organizations
2016959.summary: A practical guide to changing organization membership visibility when the member directory is difficult to navigate.
2016959.intro: Organization membership visibility determines whether an organization appears on your public GitHub profile. This guide documents a workflow for changing that setting in a large organization, using Epic Games as the example.

2001798.title: Signing Git commits with GPG
2001798.summary: Generate a GPG key, configure Git signing and verify signatures in your commit history.
2001798.intro: Signed commits attach a cryptographic signature to a Git commit. This walkthrough covers generating a GPG key, adding its public component to GitHub, configuring Git and checking the resulting signatures.

1980584.title: Building a Markdown viewer for the web
1980584.summary: The foundations of a browser-based Markdown editor: document input, rendered output and a practical setup workflow.
1980584.intro: A Markdown viewer connects a plain-text writing surface to rendered output. This guide introduces the format, walks through the features of the original web application and shows how to run the project locally.

1819015.title: Question answering over CSV data with Llama 2
1819015.summary: An experimental retrieval workflow that combines CSV documents, a pretrained language model and a chat interface.
1819015.intro: This project explores question answering over CSV data using a pretrained, quantized Llama 2 model. Retrieval supplies relevant document context; the project does not train or fine-tune the model on the uploaded data.

1817634.title: Building a document-retrieval prototype with Llama 2
1817634.summary: A Python experiment connecting reference passages to a pretrained language model through a conversational interface.
1817634.intro: This prototype retrieves passages from a medical reference document and supplies them to a pretrained, quantized Llama 2 model. It is an engineering experiment in retrieval and interface design. It has not been clinically validated and is not intended for medical decision-making.

1560531.title: Image processing with OpenCV: filters, contours and histograms
1560531.summary: Notebook examples covering resizing, morphology, filtering, thresholding and histogram analysis.
1560531.intro: This collection extends the basic image-loading workflow with common OpenCV processing operations. The examples cover resizing, morphology, contours, filtering, thresholding and histogram analysis, with links to the corresponding notebook.

1556113.title: Getting started with images in OpenCV
1556113.summary: A compact notebook-based introduction to loading and working with images using Python and OpenCV.
1556113.intro: This notebook collection introduces working with images in Python using OpenCV. Install the package, open the linked notebook and follow the accompanying examples to explore the image-processing workflow.

1554308.title: Recording and analysing audio with Python
1554308.summary: Python examples for recording audio, loading files, plotting waveforms and generating spectrograms.
1554308.intro: These examples bring together audio recording, playback and analysis in Python. The code covers loading audio, examining sample data, plotting waveforms and generating spectrograms with Librosa and Matplotlib.

1548167.title: Connecting a portfolio contact form to Google Sheets
1548167.summary: A historical implementation using browser JavaScript and Google Apps Script to store contact-form submissions.
1548167.intro: An earlier version of my portfolio used browser JavaScript and Google Apps Script to send contact-form submissions to a spreadsheet. This article records that implementation and its interface states; it describes the older project, rather than the contact flow on this website.
